from rdkit import Chem
s1='NC1=CC=C2C=N[NH]C2=C1'
s2='NC1=NC(Cl)=NC=2[NH]C=CC1=2'
m1=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s1); m2=Chem.MolFromSmiles(s2)
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(m1,canonical=True), Chem.MolToSmiles(m2,canonical=True))
for m in [m1,m2]:
 for a in m.GetAtoms(): print(a.GetIdx(),a.GetSymbol(),[(n.GetIdx(),m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(a.GetIdx(),n.GetIdx()).GetBondType()) for n in a.GetNeighbors()])
 print()
# combine, identify Cl atom and exocyclic N first atom 0
combo=Chem.CombineMols(m1,m2); rw=Chem.RWMol(combo)
cl=[a.GetIdx() for a in combo.GetAtoms() if a.GetSymbol()=='Cl'][0]
# m2 starts offset
n1=0
cl_nei=combo.GetAtomWithIdx(cl).GetNeighbors()[0].GetIdx()
# delete cl and add bond from N1 to cl_nei
rw.RemoveBond(cl,cl_nei); rw.RemoveAtom(cl)
# removal changes indices: since cl likely index after; n1 unchanged and neighbor index unchanged if cl greater
# find corresponding atom by map? after removal, use old idx adjusted
nei=cl_nei-(1 if cl<cl_nei else 0)
rw.AddBond(n1,nei,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)
p=rw.GetMol(); Chem.SanitizeMol(p)
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(p,canonical=True))
print(Chem.MolToSmiles(p,canonical=False))
